summary_en: 935,000 shares to be cancelled effective 2026-07-31. Represents 5.3% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury). Post-cancellation issued share count: 17,688,520. Executed under treasury-share retention policy capping holdings at 5% of issued shares; excess cancelled annually in July.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 2026-07-24, AMUSE Inc. resolved by board decision to cancel 935,000 treasury shares effective 2026-07-31 under the Companies Act Article 178. The cancellation is executed pursuant to a treasury-share retention policy announced in the company's May 2026 mid-term business plan, which sets a 5% ceiling on treasury-share holdings as a percentage of issued shares; shares held in excess of this limit are to be cancelled annually at end-July. Post-cancellation, issued shares will total 17,688,520 and retained treasury holdings (excluding ESOP and executive compensation trust shares) will be 884,385 shares.
